# FLX-1001: float value in a document being canonicalised

**Family:** canonicalisation (the 1000 band)

A binary floating-point number reached the canonicaliser. Floats are not reproducible across platforms and libm versions, so no hashed value may contain one (KERNEL-SPEC §2.1). Carry the number as an int or as a decimal.Decimal, which is serialised as a string at its declared scale.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-1001
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
